svg.title: Which events reach which screen
svg.desc: Animated routing diagram. The gateway sends one Server-Sent Events stream per screen. private_brief, profile_updated, deep_dive_started and deep_dive_ready go only to that person's phone (locked routes). encounter_started and encounter_completed go to both phones in the encounter and the swarm panel. connect_request, agent_decision (which carries no reason) and shared_brief go to the phone the event names and the swarm panel. exchange_message, policy_decision and pod_status go to the swarm panel only.
svg.text: The gateway routes every SSE event by fixed rules, so private content cannot drift onto the shared swarm panel.
Source: the gateway's event bus (SPEC §7.1). The swarm gets every event except the four private ones and errors meant for one phone.
Encounter · both phones in the encounter + swarm
Addressed · the phone it names + swarm
